Keeping your cool in the Nordderby!
As a referee, you always have to stay in control and manage the emotions of both teams. However, this task becomes more difficult when you find yourself in the eye of the storm, officiating the Nordderby between Werder Bremen and Hamburger SV. Watch Florian Badstübner as he takes charge of a match that could have been one of the most heated fixtures of the season. Which decision would you have made differently? Let us know in the comments!
